snippet.title: 大塚製薬「エクエル」の偽サプリ販売か 商標法違反の疑いで中国籍の男女2人逮捕　香港から輸入しフリマで販売か 約800袋押収｜TBS NEWS DIG
snippet.description:
「大塚製薬」の健康サプリメントの偽物を販売したとして、中国籍の男女2人が逮捕されました。

商標法違反の疑いで逮捕されたのは、中国籍の邸峻容疑者（55）ら男女2人です。

2人は今年5月、「大塚製薬」の健康サプリ「エクエル」の偽物を販売し、商標権を侵害した疑いがもたれています。

警視庁によりますと、2人は、偽サプリを香港から輸入し、フリマアプリで本物より1000円ほど安く販売していたとみられています。

警視庁は、2人の認否を明らかにしていませんが、関係先への家宅捜索では、偽サプリが800袋ほど押収されていて、余罪を調べています。

「エクエル」の偽サプリをめぐっては、消費者庁が、「安全性が不明」などとして注意を呼びかけていますが、現在、健康被害は確認されていないということです。

Creating a polished YouTube edit requires creativity, technical skills, and careful attention to detail. 🎬✨ For my latest Young Sheldon edit, I spent approximately 5 hours completing the entire production process, from selecting the original footage to exporting the final video. ⏱️💻

The process begins with reviewing the original episodes and selecting suitable scenes that fit the theme and overall direction of the edit. 🎞️📂 Each clip is carefully trimmed, rearranged, and connected to establish a smooth sequence while maintaining the original context and continuity. ✂️

Next comes the visual editing stage, where I focus on creating tracking effects, animated subtitles, and beat-synchronized transitions. 🔒💬🎵 Tracking effects require precise adjustments to movement, position, and timing to ensure that visual elements remain properly aligned with the footage. Meanwhile, subtitles are designed with appropriate fonts, sizes, colors, and animation effects to improve readability and visual presentation. ✨📝

Music synchronization is another important part of the process. 🎧⚡ I carefully match scene changes, visual movements, transitions, and subtitle animations with the rhythm and key beats of the background music. Every adjustment contributes to a more coordinated viewing experience. 🎶🎯

After completing the main effects, I refine the overall appearance through color correction, brightness adjustments, contrast, transitions, and additional motion effects. 🎨🎥 I also review the audio and visual elements to ensure consistency throughout the video.

Finally, the entire project goes through several rounds of inspection. 🔍 I check subtitle accuracy, effect positioning, transition timing, image quality, and synchronization before exporting the finished edit. After approximately five hours of detailed work, the Young Sheldon edit is ready for publication on YouTube. 🚀📺
